title: Define static append-only audit contract
businessObjective: Advance Phase 1 — Trusted control foundation through one bounded audit outcome.
technicalObjective: Create the version 1 static append-only audit-contract artifact and deterministic offline validator exactly as defined in docs/audit/APPEND_ONLY_AUDIT_CONTRACT.md.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, live credential access, audit-store access, database access, migration execution, RLS, queue, or external service access is authorized.
The contract and validator are static repository artifacts; the validator uses Node built-ins only and must not install packages.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/audit-sdk/append-only-audit-contract-v1.json implements the closed version 1 audit-record and append-only design specified in docs/audit/APPEND_ONLY_AUDIT_CONTRACT.md.
tests/audit/validate-append-only-audit-contract.mjs deterministically accepts the finite valid artifact and rejects every documented invalid case without network or external state.
The exact validator command and fast governance verification pass, and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P1-003 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the static audit contract, validator, task-state record, and evidence together; preserve audit and verification evidence.
